AI Notes.value: Specialist studio helping frontier-tech founders craft and distribute their narrative. Services span story coaching, founding-narrative development, newsletter and blog writing, social content (Twitter/LinkedIn), investor updates and pitch-deck support, launch campaigns, meme marketing, and short-form propaganda video (60-90 sec edits). Positions itself around strategic propaganda with modern distribution aimed at three audience tiers: evangelists, capitalists, and mass audiences. No team members, location, founders, or social profiles are published on the site, and web search did not surface any. Size and Country left empty; Instagram, LinkedIn, and Email left empty (only contact is a Typeform intake form). No seniority read is possible as the team is entirely anonymous. Work Status: Studio (self-identified). The site is a single-page services site with no published client work, case studies, named projects, or portfolio examples of any kind. The only external content is historical propaganda imagery used to illustrate the studio philosophy (French Revolution poster, Norman Rockwell, Obama Hope poster, etc.) and two external links (Kevin Kelly '1000 True Fans' article and a Notion investor-update resource). No social accounts confirmed: @DeltaStudio on X is an unrelated dormant account (0 posts, 5 followers, created 2015). IG capture not queued (no IG handle found).
